title: Wild Sri Lanka
summary: Nature end to end, from elephant country around Sigiriya to the leopards of Yala.

facts.detail: February to July for Yala; November to April for whales off Mirissa

includes.heading: What the journey includes.
includes.body: Everything below is arranged before you land, planned around the hours the animals are actually out. Flights and visas sit outside the plan, and we will say so clearly in the proposal.

items.title: Accommodation
items.body: Eight nights, from Jetwing Lake near Sigiriya and Cinnamon Kandy to DoubleTree by Hilton for the park and Jetwing Lighthouse in Galle.

items.title: Activities
items.body: The climb at Sigiriya, a jeep drive in Minneriya, the walks around Ella, two days of safaris in Yala, and whale watching off Mirissa in season.

items.title: Meals
items.body: Breakfast every day, plus the meals that are part of a stay or an early safari. The rest stays open.

items.title: Transfers and driver
items.body: Airport pick-up and drop-off, and the same driver and vehicle throughout, with park entry and jeeps arranged ahead.

itinerary.heading: The island, on the wild side.
itinerary.lede: Open a day to see what it holds and where you sleep.

days.title: Rock Fortress and Wildlife
days.body: Day one, the climb up Sigiriya, the rock fortress above the plain. Day two, a jeep drive in Minneriya National Park, where elephants gather at the water.

days.title: The Last Kingdom in Sri Lanka
days.body: Discover Sri Lanka’s cultural heart with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, scenic Kandy Lake, lush hills, and rich traditions.

days.title: Where the Train Threads the Jungle
days.body: An active hill day: Little Adam’s Peak, the Nine Arches Bridge and Ravana Falls, alive with birds and butterflies.

photos.caption: Nine Arches Bridge above the tea

days.title: The Highest Leopard Density on Earth
days.body: The heart of the trip. Two days of safaris for leopards, elephants, sloth bears and dazzling birdlife.

photos.caption: A safari jeep under the trees

days.title: Fort, Beach and Blue Whales
days.body: Wind down at the fort and the beach. In season (November to April), add blue whale watching off nearby Mirissa.

days.title: Home Bound
days.body: This morning you’ll be driven to the airport at Colombo to board your flight home. Time to revel in the memories and plan your next trip.

stay.name: Private transfer
stay.note: Colombo airport, timed to your flight.

timeAnswer: Nine days gives Yala two full days, which is what finding a leopard usually takes. Shorter trips usually mean dropping a stop, not a safari.
